title: Use mail on web and phone
problem: There was no way to read the mail or set up a phone.
now: Webmail opens from Apps; a QR code and the IMAP / SMTP settings set up phones; old mail can be imported.
steps: Scan the QR code, or open webmail.
Start an import from an old host.
notes: Where: Business email › Apps · Needs the server: Webmail is a stand-in for the provider's.
